rationale: Select the registered pocket family, which uses only the original receptor crop and has no generated-Steer or bound-ligand reward dependency. Use a modest contact term and repulsion weight 1 as exploratory geometric-proxy settings; compare the lower RMS ratio and a linear time ramp while evaluating the specified final FLOWR predicted target pIC50 objective. These settings are hypotheses, not affinity-supported conclusions.
failure_modes: The receptor coordinates have no affinity labels, so the geometric proxy may not improve predicted target pIC50.
Nearest-neighbor quantiles alone do not identify atom-pair clashes or interaction motifs; repulsion weight 1 may be insufficient or excessive.
The pocket objective omits ligand attraction and may constrain geometry without favoring productive ligand interactions.
